name: Snatch (Mythic)
body:
This creature’s crushing grip mangles its prey and renders it defenseless.

Prerequisite(s): Snatch.

Benefit(s): A creature with this feat can expend one use of mythic power as a swift action when making a grapple check. If the combat maneuver check succeeds, the target is automatically pinned instead of grappled, and its penalty to AC is increased by an amount equal to the creature’s mythic rank for as long as it remains grappled or pinned.
